title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program Points Accounting — Inactivity Expiry, Return Clawback and Negative Balances
content:
Three points-account terms of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program are fixed per tier: how long a points balance survives without activity, whether points on returned merchandise are taken back, and whether a points balance may go below zero.

| Tier | Full calendar months without activity before the whole balance expires | Points on returned merchandise deducted | Deduction may take the balance below zero |
|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Finch Circle Silver | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Finch Circle Gold | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 18 | Yes | Yes |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 24 | Yes | Yes |
| Finch Circle Icon | 24 | Yes | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Inactivity expiry** — the full calendar months without any points earned or note redeemed after which the whole points balance expires, a whole number of months.
- **Return clawback** — whether points earned on returned merchandise are deducted; at every tier they are.
- **Negative balance allowed** — whether a points deduction may take the balance below zero; at every tier it may.

## Reading the table (hypothetical)

- A Finch Circle Platinum member has 18 full calendar months; a Finch Circle Silver member has 12.
- A member at any tier holding 300 points whose return deduction is 450 points ends with a balance of minus 150 points.
